note: Talents present in the Wowhead 12.1.5 trees but NOT modeled in our Inputs sheet, so they would otherwise surface as 'new' nodes in every wowhead_diff run. Our Inputs sheet only lists the build-SELECTED hero talents, so the rest of the hero trees always look new — this list turns that index artifact into a 'known-unmodeled' category and keeps NEW clean for genuinely-new nodes. 'unmodeled' = in the Wowhead trees, not in our index (the 21 hero nodes from the 2026-10-18 report). 'removed_known' = in our index, known to be absent from the Wowhead trees (Death's Bargain). Keep this list in sync with the Inputs sheet: when a talent becomes modeled, remove it here; when a new unmatched node is reviewed and accepted as expected, add it here. Tree names match game.json index.talents tree values / the report's tree labels.
